name: a failed write does not reach DynamoDB
the record is kept on this device and flagged dirty
a successful read does not discard the unsaved record
the queued write is retried and lands in DynamoDB
the dirty flag clears once the retry succeeds
a failed delete leaves a tombstone
the tombstoned record does not reappear after a reload
the failed delete is retried against DynamoDB
the tombstone clears once the retry succeeds
the racing draft exists locally before the delete
the deleted questionnaire is not recreated by the in-flight save
and it does not reappear in the UI
its KB entry was still created
